settings.title: Email notifications
settings.description: Notifications always show in the app. Choose which ones also come by email.

alwaysOn.candidate: Always sent: password reset, verification and moderation decisions, certificates, a failed renewal and the end of your plan.
alwaysOn.recruiter: Always sent: password reset, account decisions (approved, rejected, suspended), moderation decisions and certificates.
alwaysOn.admin: Always sent: password reset and invitations.

categories.interviews: Reminders 24 hours and 1 hour before an interview, and when a candidate has answered a document request. Invitations and changes are always sent.
categories.applications: Status changes on your applications, including when you are not selected.
categories.messages: A message still unread after 15 minutes, at most one email per conversation an hour.
categories.cv_requests: A company asks to see an earlier version of your CV.
categories.job_alerts: New jobs that match your job alerts, at the frequency you chose.
categories.new_applications: New applications to your jobs, at most one email per job an hour.
categories.account_reviews: A recruiter submits or resubmits an account for review.
categories.verification: A candidate submits evidence for a verification check.
categories.content_reports: Someone reports a job, a profile, a company or a message.
categories.failed_renewals: A candidate’s Plus renewal payment fails.
categories.admin_joined: An invited admin accepts the invitation.
